channel.title: TCEA Vibe-Coded Solutions — Updates
channel.description: New and updated HTML tools, dashboards, prompt libraries, and classroom resources from TCEA.

item.title: 🕵️ Idioms & Sayings for Multilingual Learners
item.description: A multilingual idioms & sayings suite for grades 3–12 — decode English idioms with your home language as a resource (ESL) and compare sayings across languages, starting with English & Spanish. Aligned to the Texas ELPS (idiomatic expressions) and WIDA; seven languages, no logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Idioms & Sayings Standards Alignment (ELPS / TEKS)
item.description: How the Idioms & Sayings suite aligns to the Texas ELPS (19 TAC §74.4), the ELAR TEKS, and the LOTE TEKS for Bilingual/ESL and multilingual classrooms — with a K–12 public-school appropriateness statement and links to the Texas EL program frameworks.

item.title: 🕵️ Critical Thinking Online Breakouts — Full Library
item.description: A single searchable library of every TCEA Critical Thinking Online Breakout (CTOB) — 193 self-contained, browser-based reasoning escapes across five suites (CLEAR, Fourth of July, July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays, Bible as Literature, and Science) in seven languages. Search by name, topic, or grade; no logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Bible as Literature Breakouts
item.description: Thirty-one critical-thinking breakouts on the Texas-adopted Bible stories, studied academically — as literature and history, never devotionally. Covers every K–12 required-list Bible item (creation, Noah, David & Goliath, the Psalms, the Prodigal Son, Job, 1 Corinthians 13, and more) across four grade bands, in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Bible as Literature Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A TEKS correlation guide mapping each Bible as Literature breakout to the ELAR strands, the CLEAR reasoning focus, and the high-effect-size instructional strategy engineered into its locks.

item.title: 🕵️ Science Critical Thinking Breakouts (Grades K–8)
item.description: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts across the Texas science TEKS, Grades K–8 — from pushes and pulls to conservation of mass. Each grade has a featured breakout, a concept set, a hands-on STEM engineering design challenge, and a student word bank, in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Science Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the Science Critical Thinking Breakouts by grade to the Texas science TEKS and the reasoning moves engineered into each lock.

item.title: 🕵️ Critical Thinking Breakouts
item.description: Grade-band breakout activities (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) across ELA, science, and social studies that teach evidence-based reasoning, available in seven languages.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Critical Thinking Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained U.S. history escape activities across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12). Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each — building history knowledge and critical-thinking habits. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts
item.description: Twelve self-contained critical thinking breakouts across three grade bands (3-5, 6-8, 9-12) exploring the freedom days the calendar often overlooks — Frederick Douglass s July 5 address, Juneteenth, Pinkster, Watch Night, and more. Students open clues, weigh evidence, and crack four locks each. No logins, no data collected.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A multilingual correlation guide mapping the Critical Thinking Breakouts to standards and thinking skills.

item.title: 🕵️ Fourth of July Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve Fourth of July breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 🕵️ Black Freedom Holidays Breakouts Correlation Guide
item.description: A standards correlation guide mapping the twelve July 5 & Black Freedom Holidays breakouts by grade band to Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills, Common Core literacy standards, and the CLEAR thinking process.

item.title: 🕵️ Breakouts Answer Key
item.description: The facilitator answer key and recording sheet for running the Critical Thinking Breakouts activities.

item.title: 📊 Data Display Patterns
item.description: A TCEA field guide to choosing the right chart and data-display pattern for dashboards and reports.

item.title: 📊 Assessment System RFP Scoring Tool
item.description: A weighted rubric for comparing district assessment systems, with non-negotiable gate checks and a side-by-side vendor comparison you can export to CSV.

item.title: 🕵️ The CLEAR Crew — Detective Thinking Game
item.description: Crack the case one clue at a time with the CLEAR thinking process — a critical-thinking checklist for young detectives.

item.title: 📊 School District App Intake Form
item.description: A teacher and staff app intake form for submitting apps for district review, with an optional Google Sheets backend for collecting requests.

item.title: 🤖 LibVibes Prompt Library
item.description: Nineteen library-focused vibe-coding starter prompts, each with a VIBES game plan and its own linkable page, all nineteen built and playable.

item.title: ⭐ Codex Project Organizer
item.description: A beginner-friendly brief builder that turns a project idea into a structured Markdown prompt for AI-assisted coding, with a modular version for defining inputs, outputs, and tests.

item.title: ⭐ TCEA Tools Menu
item.description: The launch menu for classroom utilities including spinners, dice, word search, drawing, puzzles, and fortune tools.

item.title: 🧰 Classroom Shape Spinner
item.description: A shape spinner for math, discussion, selection, and quick classroom activities.

item.title: 🎲 Vibe Coding Projects for Librarians
item.description: The session companion site with library use cases, starter prompts, and downloadable tools for vibe-coding free alternatives to Padlet, Slido, and FigJam.

item.title: ⭐ Vibe-Coding for Librarians
item.description: A companion website with librarian-focused tools, use cases, prompts, and downloadable vibe-coding resources.

item.title: 🤖 TCEA AI Custom Instructions Library
item.description: Reusable AI personas and custom instructions for productivity, planning, writing, and educator workflows.

item.title: 🤖 AI Essentials Prompt Library of 100
item.description: A searchable set of educator prompts for AI Essentials training and classroom support.

item.title: 🤖 K-12 Image Prompt Library
item.description: Classroom, library, and office-ready image prompts organized by task and instructional use.

item.description: An interactive roadmap for district and campus AI adoption stages, policies, and implementation moves.

item.title: 🤖 AI Adoption Roadmap - Extended
item.description: The longer version of the AI adoption roadmap with expanded guidance and phase detail.

item.description: A 15-minute interactive guide for reviewing app permissions on a child's device.

item.description: Create classroom word searches from custom terms and themes.

item.description: Create and configure meme-based puzzles for classroom use.
